# tenex/.codex

Repo-scoped Codex (CLI / Desktop / IDE) config. Mirrors `.claude/` for the Codex side.

## Generated by rulesync

- `.codex/rules/` and `AGENTS.md` (root) — fan out from `.rulesync/rules/`
- `.codex/config.toml` — MCP servers from `.rulesync/.mcp.json`

## Hand-authored

- `.codex/agents/*.toml` — Codex subagents (TOML format; the format diverges from Claude's Markdown subagents, so we maintain them separately when needed).

## Skills (shared)

`.codex/skills/` is a symlink to `../skills/`. The Agent Skills spec (`agentskills.io`) is byte-identical between Claude Code and Codex, so the same SKILL.md works in both.
